name: DolphinBench routed-v2 fixed20 — iteration 1 (eager tools + system-prompt route note)
objective: Run exactly the frozen 20 IDs once under dolphin-routed-v2 with checkpoint=false; independently validate all grades, evidence, costs and control regressions and deliver a human-readable report. Preserve historical results; never launch full600.
plan:
Run only the exact contracted command worker once. The controller needs the existing private/MEM paths; the benchmark agent retains its isolated native sandbox and ordinary Hermes inventory plus the staged atmem-action-guard plugin with checkpoint=false. No worker-model inference is involved in dispatch. Reader Luna/high subscription, judge Sol/medium OpenRouter Azure-only, local memory/retrieval/Ollama and disabled state assessors remain frozen. Pilot cap US$10 incremental API spend; supervision billing remains separate. Qualification receipts must already exist and match the new20 condition. Do not fall back to old60 receipts or attempt hand-written qualification. No source/config/validator changes while running, automatic repair, package upgrade, full600, new reader/ingestion, or fixture patching.

Supervised recovery uses resumeArgv, which is inspect-only: never replace it with argv or relaunch scored work at another output. At most two recovery attempts/two read-only supervisor calls. Inspect actual process, immutable logs/state, reservations and markers before recommending recovery. An uncertain action or partial pilot requires operator reconciliation. Never delete evidence, clear inflight, reset app state, reroll verdicts or invent charges. Do not escalate a resolved OAuth problem without new evidence; do not request real Notes/GitHub/Google credentials. Completion requires exactly20 unique selected IDs, actual independent state/log evidence, original full check layout, reconciled costs and no control regressions. The command writes the handoff only from real report/receipt evidence; the independent validator decides acceptance. The three original failure cohorts remain separate. The 20-case pilot is post hoc and not a new600 score;75.4% remains conditional. A passing pilot cannot itself authorize full600.

Read the feature spec, runbook, verification, remediation-status and atsys/README before diagnosing. Read-only supervisor must not run workloads, modify authority or fabricate facts. If stopped by mount/auth/budget/changed hashes, report exact evidence; keep the original390/600 score unchanged.
The direct command worker forwards termination to an isolated benchmark process group and monitors parent liveness. Retries remain inspection-only. A killed/interrupted provider request retains uncertainty; never infer zero charge or safe replay. Qualification must be fresh at immediate launch; complete the pilot and validation within the24h receipt window, otherwise stop for renewed qualification without replay.

Owner authorization 2026-10-31: separate routed post hoc diagnostic, same fixed20/models/memory/grading. run_routed.py emits execution/grade progress counts every30s and an honest terminal report even on failure. No coding repair authorized. Stop after any qualification or submission failure; submit only once.

Exactly one v2 submission.
